expire.description: string parsed by time.ParseDuration, examples include: infinite, 8h, 30m, 20s

role.description: type of model.Role, valid options: disabled, user, admin

username.description: username shown in logs, does not need to be a valid user in the DB

by_serial.description: Asset tag for each serial number. A selected node whose serial is not listed fails

dry_run.description: Read the bmcs and report what would change, without writing

template.description: Go template rendered per node, such as UB-{{.Name}}. A plain string is a valid template

all.description: Clear every job in the queue. Mutually exclusive with ids

file.description: BMC config template to import, by its name in the provision templates. Each iDRAC downloads it from Grendel's provision server

shutdown_type.description: NoReboot queues the import until the node next reboots. Graceful and Forced reboot the node to apply it. Defaults to NoReboot

apply_update.description: false only compares the installed firmware against the catalog, which firmware/updates then lists. true queues every available update as a job

catalog_file.description: Catalog file name on the share. The iDRAC defaults to Catalog.xml

clear_jobs.description: Clear every job in the queue first. Requires apply_update

ignore_cert_warning.description: Accept an HTTPS share whose certificate does not validate

ip_address.description: Domain name or IP address of the share holding the catalog

reboot.description: Reboot the node when an update needs it. Otherwise the updates wait as scheduled jobs until the node next reboots

share_name.description: Path of the catalog's directory on the share, or the NFS export

dry_run.description: Read the bmcs and report what would change, without writing

rack_unit.description: Must render to a whole number

action.description: schemas.ResetType. On, ForceOn, ForceOff, ForceRestart, GracefulRestart, GracefulShutdown, PowerCycle, Nmi, PushPowerButton, Suspend, Pause, Resume, FullPowerCycle

boot_override.description: schemas.BootSource to boot from once. None, Pxe, Floppy, Cd, Usb, Hdd, BiosSetup, Utilities, Diags, UefiShell, UefiTarget, SDCard, UefiHttp, RemoteDrive, UefiBootNext, Recovery

target.description: What to power, 'host' or 'bmc'. Defaults to host. A bmc target is always a graceful restart and ignores the other fields

apply_time.description: When the bmc applies the change. Immediate, OnReset, AtMaintenanceWindowStart or InMaintenanceWindowOnReset, limited to what each bmc accepts. Empty for the bmc's default

attributes.description: Attribute names and their new values. A string value is converted to the number or boolean the attribute holds

type.description: URL of the error type. Can be used to lookup the error in a documentation

role.description: type of model.Role, valid options: disabled, user, admin
